content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the IIT Indore Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 12 vacancies are available - 9 for Junior Research Fellow, 1 for Research Associate Provisional, and 2 for Research Associate II.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course selected through National Eligibility Tests – CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments. Research Associate Provisional: Ph.D. Thesis Submitted. Research Associate II: Ph.D. + 1 year of experience.

content_sections.heading: IIT Indore Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Junior Research Fellow: ₹37,000 + HRA Per Month Research Associate Provisional: ₹45,000 + HRA Per Month Research Associate II: ₹61,000 + HRA Per Month

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 27-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Indore to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Junior Research Fellow / Research Associate posts is 27th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Junior Research Fellow / Research Associate posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 12 vacancies announced by IIT Indore for the positions of Junior Research Fellow and Research Associate. These are distributed across different categories of the posts.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026 is entirely online. Candidates are required to submit their applications through the official IIT Indore website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary for the Junior Research Fellow / Research Associate positions ranges from Rs. 37,000 to Rs. 61,000 per month, plus HRA, depending on the specific post and qualifications.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligibility criteria for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Junior Research Fellow position, candidates must have a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science or a Graduate/Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course, selected through CSIR-UGC NET/GATE or equivalent national tests.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will involve shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview. Candidates are advised to prepare for both stages.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for the recruited candidates?
faq.answer: The positions of Junior Research Fellow / Research Associate at IIT Indore are on a contractual basis. This means the employment is for a fixed tenure as per the project requirements.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF and the online application link are provided in the "Important Links" section of this article for your convenience. Please check these links for detailed information.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of IIT Indore?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Indore is located in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, with the pincode 453552.
